epic.title: Margot for CCW — omni-channel AI brand voice (phone, email, booking, orders, marketing)
epic.description: R&D complete 2026-07-06. Extend the existing CCW Phone Agent scaffold (UNI-2140) in CCW-CRM into Margot: one shared knowledge core + persona with per-channel adapters. CCW-owned Twilio + ElevenLabs accounts, integrated with CCW's existing phone system. Full report: margot-ccw-rnd.md (session scratchpad; to be committed to CCW-CRM docs/).

tickets.title: Discovery: CCW phone stack per site + port-vs-forward decision
tickets.description: Identify PBX/phone system at Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne; current after-hours flows; decide port numbers to Twilio vs forward. Output: call-flow diagram per site.

tickets.title: Provision CCW-owned Twilio + ElevenLabs accounts
tickets.description: CCW-billed accounts, Unite-Group delegated admin. Twilio AU regulatory bundle under CCW ABN (ASIC extract, address, rep ID). 3 local numbers: 07 Brisbane, 02 Sydney, 03 Melbourne.

tickets.title: AU-accent STT bake-off on real CCW calls
tickets.description: Record sample real calls (with consent notice), benchmark ElevenLabs/Deepgram/Google STT WER on AU trade speech incl. warehouse noise. Research finding: AU-accent ASR accuracy is the binding constraint, not latency. Gate: WER threshold met before P2 build.

tickets.title: Compliance pack: disclosure greeting + counsel review
tickets.description: One greeting covering recording consent (NSW all-party via implied consent, SDA 2007 s7; QLD/VIC one-party) + AI self-identification (OAIC) + APP 5 notice. AU privacy counsel sign-off before go-live.

tickets.title: Scoped service auth for voice agent
tickets.description: Replace CRON_SECRET owner-impersonation with scoped API key for the voice-agent service; add RBAC to phone-agent admin routes (currently any workspace member can approve/configure).

tickets.title: First-class Branch model
tickets.description: DB-backed Branch (address, phone, hours, timezone) for the 3 sites; branchId on CcwAiCallSession and order-draft flow; replace hardcoded location strings.

tickets.title: Knowledge ingestion pipeline (pgvector)
tickets.description: Enable pgvector on Supabase; ingest product descriptive text (ccwonline.com.au/products.json + Cin7), parts/services, branch info, CARSI course catalog into CcwAiKnowledgeSource with real content storage + embeddings + lastIndexedAt.

tickets.title: SDS pipeline: verbatim-only delivery
tickets.description: Parse ProductSds.sdsPdfUrl PDFs into verbatim field store keyed by GHS section; staleness check vs reviewDueDate (5-year rule, WHS Reg 330); delivery = email/SMS the actual PDF + read exact field text. HARD RULE: never paraphrase hazard/first-aid/PPE/mixing content; no-match => human escalation. Log SDS version/section read per call.

tickets.title: Retrieval API with cited-answer contract
tickets.description: Retrieval endpoint returning chunks + source IDs; every Margot answer carries its citation; low-confidence => escalate, never improvise.

tickets.title: Mid-call tool endpoints
tickets.description: Voice-agent tool API wrapping: stock-by-branch, customer-tier pricing, customer-by-phone, branch hours/pickup, SDS-send, service-slot availability. Transport-agnostic (ElevenLabs tool webhooks now, ConversationRelay-compatible later).

tickets.title: Margot persona + branch routing on ElevenLabs agent
tickets.description: Margot system persona (offer-based selling, tone), 3 Twilio numbers => branch parameter scoping every tool call; barge-in tuning; warm transfer into CCW's existing phone system with AI call summary handed to staff.

tickets.title: Draft-order-from-call flow
tickets.description: Call session => proposed lines => draft Order/Quote linked to CcwAiCallSession; reserveInventoryUntil EOD; full transcript + confirmed-items in order note; human finalisation queue. NEVER: complete order, capture payment, exceed qty/spend cap. Scopes: write_draft_orders equivalent only.

tickets.title: Inbound email answering from shared knowledge core
tickets.description: Same retrieval + persona, email tone adapter; human-approved sends initially; autonomous only for transactional (booking confirmations, SDS delivery) per Spam Act 2003.

tickets.title: Service-bay booking via WorkshopBooking
tickets.description: check_availability / book_appointment tools against WorkshopBooking; confirmation email/SMS transactional send.

tickets.title: Offer-engine: live-FOMO + CARSI attach
tickets.description: Suggestive selling from LIVE ERP stock/promo fields only (ACCC bright line — Emma Sleep precedent: no static/looping urgency); offer-once rule; CARSI course cross-sell attach. Disclose Margot is AI.

tickets.title: Marketing campaigns via Synthex with human send-gate
tickets.description: Margot drafts + segments; human clicks approve/send; Spam Act consent/unsubscribe/sender-ID enforced in template layer.

tickets.title: Margot KPI dashboard
tickets.description: Deflection rate, draft-order conversion, transfer rate, admin hours freed, offer attach rate. Baseline captured in P0 discovery.
